As a church we have group ministries and you are
requested to be actively involved in your ministry.
SUNDAY SCHOOL MINISTRY -- for our children
YOUTHS MINISTRY -- for our young gentlemen
and ladies who are not married
DORCAS MINISTRY -- for our women (we have a
sub ministry under Dorcas called Exodus 22/22
for more information you can see our Chairlady)
We also have other service ministries in the
